environment.description: Same container image deployed on a hardened Kubernetes pod with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile loaded via RuntimeDefault+ annotation (seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod: 'localhost/jwt-service-hardened.json'). The profile is derived from the strace output of normal operation and uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for syscall numbers 59 (execve), 322 (execveat), 101 (ptrace), 41 (socket after init), and 57 (fork/clone variants). The profile permits read/write/openat/close/mmap/futex/epoll_wait which are sufficient for the Actix-web event loop and file reads. Additionally, the pod runs with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and the /etc/keys volume is mounted from a Kubernetes Secret with mode 0400. The service account has no RBAC bindings beyond the default.

seccomp_blocked_syscalls.name: socket
seccomp_blocked_syscalls.note: blocked after listener fd is established via SCMP_ACT_NOTIFY with agent

seccomp_blocked_syscalls.name: clone
seccomp_blocked_syscalls.note: CLONE_THREAD still permitted for tokio runtime
